captions.detailed: This 3D model is a robust, right-angle bracket featuring a wide triangular gusset brace on the inner corner for structural reinforcement. Each leg of the bracket is flat and rectangular, containing two evenly spaced mounting holes. The brace is located flush with one of the outer edges of the bracket width, leaving the rest of the inner corner open.
captions.instruction: Create a customizable, parametric L-bracket with an optional triangular reinforcement brace. Users should be able to adjust the leg span, material thickness, bracket width, brace thickness, and the position and diameter of the mounting holes on each leg.
captions.factory: The script defines the bracket body by extruding a 2D L-shaped polygon to the specified bracket width. The triangular brace is similarly created by extruding a 2D triangular polygon, which is conditionally unioned at either the bottom, top, or both ends of the bracket width. Finally, the mounting holes are subtracted using the difference operator, created from rotated cylinders positioned along each leg according to percentage-based spacing parameters.
